description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Pilikuttuwa, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District - (25/0196)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and property ownership matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, and title classifications. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements.
